working_definition: Epithelial cells of the adult midgut-hindgut hybrid zone from the gut analysis (Li et al. 2022; author term FBbt:00047207, the zone structure).
searches_performed: epithelial cell of the adult midgut-hindgut hybrid zone

best_match.fbbt_term: epithelial cell of the adult midgut-hindgut hybrid zone
best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell of the adult gut epithelium at the boundary between the midgut and the hindgut. There are approximately 125 of such cells in mature adults (day 4), down from 300 during pupation. They express wingless, along with markers characteristic of both the midgut and the hindgut (Sawyer et al., 2017).

justification: Cell-level equivalent of the authors' zone term; same source (Sawyer et al. 2017) and region.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Ring of small cells between the adult midgut and hindgut that express markers of both regions, as well as wingless (Sawyer et al., 2017).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors' term; a structure rather than a cell term.
